The following events took place in '''23 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Second Imperium Crisis]].<ref name="YJK:SA" />
*The [[Second Imperium]] and the [[Shadow Academy]] were [[Third Battle of Yavin|destroyed]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[New Jedi Order]] above [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="YJK:JUS">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Under Siege]]''</ref>
*Formation of the [[Diversity Alliance]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>
*[[New Republic Presidential election, 23 ABY|New Republic Presidential election]]; [[Borsk Fey'lya]] succeeded [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]].
